Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: Customer Service Executive
description:
At Bike Club, we offer subscriptions for children's bikes that grow with your kids. Families pay a monthly fee, and when their children outgrow their bikes, we exchange them for a larger size. We refurbish the used bikes and make them available to other families. It's sustainable and hassle-free.

With over 80,000 bikes, we are the second-largest bike rental network globally, and the largest in the children's bike sector. While our headquarters is in the United Kingdom, we are also active in Germany.

Tasks

At Bike Club, our members come first, and our Customer Service and Success Team is what brings that to life. It's a role that blends service with a proactive mindset. Part of it is the day-to-day: helping members with subscriptions, billing, deliveries and choosing the right bike. The rest is proactive: reaching out at the right moments, supporting retention, and making sure every family feels looked after from start to finish. No two days are the same, and we love it that way! You will:

  • Handle member queries across multiple channels, including email, telephone, and social media.
  • Develop expert product knowledge of our bicycle range to offer tailored advice and recommendations to our members.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by gathering feedback and sharing insights with your team.
  • Conduct proactive outreach to members at key moments in their journey.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively, ensuring information is always shared clearly and concisely.
  • Demonstrate a solution-focused approach by resolving issues on the first contact whenever possible.

This role will grow as our team does, so if you like the idea of shaping something rather than slotting into a fixed box, you'll fit right in.

Requirements

  • Genuinely care about offering the highest level of customer service.
  • Previous experience with CRM tools, preferably Salesforce.
  • A proactive mindset, happy to reach out to members at the right moments rather than waiting for them to come to you.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, coupled with a natural curiosity and a desire to learn.
  • A high level of empathy and a commitment to exceeding customer expectations.
  • You actively seek out feedback to help yourself grow and improve.
  • Love the dynamic of a team environment, but are just as comfortable working independently.
  • You can remain positive when the going gets tough and when working under pressure.
  • A dependable, organised, and dedicated team player.
  • At least 1 year of real-life experience in a similar role.

Benefits

  • Remote first – work from anywhere in the UK. You will be required to attend a monthly in-person team meeting at our warehouse in East London
  • Flexible hours – 37.5 working hours per week. While some weekend availability is required, we’re open to different work patterns. Our core hours are Monday - Friday, 9 am - 5:30 pm.
  • Holidays – 26 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with additional days accrued for each year worked
  • Private health insurance - via Vitality
  • Sustainability impact – you will be working for a B Corp Certified company that actively contributes to environmental and social good
  • Parental leave – enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • Bike subscription – £30/month discount towards Bike Club subscription

Apply Today! We invite you to forward your CV and a cover letter expressing your enthusiasm for the core values and vision of Bike Club. Join us, and let’s embark on this trailblazing journey together!

description: Headquarters: Big Bear Lake, California, USA URL: https://www.bigbearvacations.com/ OWNER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST Department: Owner Relations / Owner Experience Market: Puerto Vallarta & Nuevo Vallarta, Mexico Reports To: Director of Owner Relations Employment Type: Contractor Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Monday - Saturday Compensation: USD $1,200 monthly Languages: Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken — required Position Purpose The Owner Experience Specialist is the primary point of contact between Naya Homes and our homeowners in Puerto Vallarta and Nuevo Vallarta. This role is responsible for building and maintaining strong, consistent, and proactive relationships with homeowners in order to support owner satisfaction and retention. Rather than simply reacting to problems after they occur, the Specialist is expected to identify potential concerns early and address them before they become reasons for an owner to consider terminating their relationship with Naya Homes. The Specialist owns three key outcomes: executing the required owner communication cadence under the 33-Touch Relationship Model; providing homeowners with clear visibility into the condition and performance of their properties; and capturing property content that supports marketing efforts, social media, and owner communication. The successful candidate will be highly organized, proactive, customer-focused, and comfortable managing a high volume of daily communication while maintaining accurate documentation and consistent follow-up. Fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken, is an indispensable requirement for this position. The Specialist will communicate with homeowners and internal teams in both languages. Because this is a remote contractor position, the primary focus is on achieving established goals, service standards, and KPIs. The schedule may be flexible as needed to ensure objectives are met, while maintaining the required availability and responsiveness for homeowners and the business. Core Responsibilities 1. Owner Relationship Management & Communication • Execute 20–25 documented owner interactions per day through calls, email, and text. • Maintain 100% completion of required monthly touches for every assigned owner under the 33-Touch Relationship Model. • Maintain a balance across the three touch types: • Property Visibility: condition updates, inspection findings, photos, and property content. • Personal Relationship: relationship-building communication not directly related to a transaction or problem. • Informative / Value-Driven: performance, pricing, market conditions, and seasonal outlook. • Enter every interaction with a clear purpose and conclude it with a defined next step. • Complete scheduled owner check-in calls on the day they are due and rebook any rescheduled calls before the end of the same business day. • Maintain clear communication regarding availability, support, and expected response times so owners always know who to contact and when they can expect an answer. • Build trust and maintain professional, long-term relationships with homeowners. 2. Property Visibility & Owner Updates • Collect property updates from Operations, Housekeeping, Maintenance, and inspection reports. • Review condition notes and available photos before communicating with owners to ensure updates are specific and accurate. • Translate operational findings into clear, plain-language owner updates, including what was found, what action is being taken, associated costs, and expected resolution timelines. • Respond to all open owner conversations regarding work orders. • Ensure that no work order is dispatched to an owner's property without documented owner approval. • Ensure that every unresolved property issue has a clearly assigned next action and responsible person. • Provide owners with meaningful visibility into the work being performed on their property. 3. Escalation & Churn Risk Identification • Identify early signs of owner dissatisfaction or potential churn, including declining sentiment, slow or short responses, revenue complaints, recurring property condition issues, questions regarding contract terms, or references to other management companies. • Escalate concerns on the same business day. • Add applicable owners to the Owner Churn Board and keep records current as situations develop. • Confirm ownership of the next action for every escalation and ensure each open case has a clearly assigned responsible person. • Communicate potential risks early rather than waiting for issues to escalate. 4. Documentation & CRM Discipline • Log every owner interaction in Monday.com on the same day it occurs. • Maintain the Owner Churn Board on a daily basis. • Schedule all future owner touches and follow-ups before closing out the day. • Prepare a clear next-day action list before logging off. • Complete a weekly CRM documentation self-audit and correct any gaps identified. • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely records of all owner communications. Daily Operating Rhythm Start of Day • Log into RingCentral and Monday.com. • Review the Owner Engagement Tracker. • Identify owners due for required touches. • Review notes from inspections, maintenance, turnovers, and operations. • Flag owners with open concerns, negative or declining sentiment, or recent performance or condition issues. During the Day • Complete scheduled owner check-in calls. • Send required emails and text messages. • Complete scheduled property-content activities remotely or through available internal resources. • Collect and communicate relevant property updates. • Respond to open work order conversations. • Escalate concerns on the same business day. • Maintain consistent follow-up with assigned homeowners. End of Day • Ensure all owner interactions are documented in Monday.com. • Update the Owner Churn Board. • Schedule future touches and follow-ups. • Confirm that there are zero undocumented conversations. • Prepare the next-day action list. Weekly Close • Maintain 100% progress toward required monthly owner touches. • Ensure there are no missed follow-ups. • Complete the CRM documentation self-audit. • Review owner sentiment trends. • Identify unresolved owner issues requiring attention. • Identify owners requiring proactive outreach during the following week. Performance Standards & KPIs Performance will be measured monthly against the following targets: • Daily owner touches: 20–25 per day. • Required monthly touch completion: 100%. • Documentation accuracy: 95% or higher. • Undocumented conversations: Zero. • Same-day escalation compliance: 100%. • Overdue escalations beyond SLA: Zero. • Owner sentiment trend: Stable or improving. • Overall KPI attainment: 90% or higher. • Retention saves: Tracked and reviewed through the Owner Churn Board. Sustained performance below the established targets may result in a documented coaching plan. Accountability Standards • Missed follow-ups are considered a performance issue. • Undocumented conversations are considered a performance issue. • Dispatching a work order without documented owner approval is considered a performance issue. • Early escalation is considered a positive behavior and is recognized accordingly. • Proactive communication is an expectation of the role, not an additional benefit or optional activity. • The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned conversations, follow-ups, and open issues through resolution or appropriate escalation. Qualifications Required • Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken — indispensable. • 2+ years of experience in client-facing account management, hospitality, property management, customer success, or a related field. • Demonstrated experience working independently and managing responsibilities in a remote environment. • Strong CRM discipline and a proven track record of documenting work consistently without requiring constant follow-up. • Comfortable initiating a high volume of outbound calls and handling difficult conversations directly and professionally. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish. • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with clients and maintain long-term relationships. • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple conversations, follow-ups, and priorities simultaneously. • Proactive approach to identifying potential dissatisfaction and escalating concerns appropriately. • Ability to shoot and edit short-form vertical video using a phone and tools such as CapCut, Instagram, or equivalent. • Strong computer skills and ability to work independently with digital communication, CRM, and collaboration tools. • Reliable internet connection and a suitable home-office environment for remote work. Preferred • Previous experience in short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, or property management. • Working knowledge of Streamline VRS, Monday.com, or comparable PMS/CRM platforms. • Experience producing content for Instagram, TikTok, Airbnb, or other property marketing platforms. • Understanding of owner statements, management fees, and short-term rental revenue basics. • Familiarity with the Puerto Vallarta / Nuevo Vallarta vacation rental market. Key Attributes The ideal candidate will be: • Reliable and consistent: Able to perform repetitive activities consistently and accurately. • Calm and professional: Comfortable dealing with frustrated homeowners without becoming defensive or over-promising. • Highly organized: Capable of managing 20–25 daily conversations while maintaining complete follow-up. • Proactive: Identifies potential issues early and takes action before they escalate. • Accountable: Communicates problems honestly and takes ownership of mistakes. • Relationship-oriented: Genuinely interested in understanding homeowners, their properties, and their needs. • Adaptable: Comfortable working independently in a remote environment and managing priorities without constant supervision. • Strong communicator: Able to communicate clearly and professionally in both English and Spanish. First 90 Days Days 1–30 • Complete access and onboarding for Monday.com, Streamline, RingCentral, and the Owner Engagement Tracker. • Become confident using the required systems and communication tools. • Review the assigned owner portfolio. • Make introductory contact with assigned homeowners. • Complete shadowing and initial training. Days 31–60 • Execute the full daily communication volume of 20–25 owner touches. • Maintain 100% documentation compliance. • Demonstrate consistent follow-up and proactive communication. • Begin independently identifying and escalating owner concerns. Days 61–90 • Achieve overall KPI attainment of 90% or higher. • Own at least one owner retention case from identification through resolution or successful escalation. • Demonstrate consistent owner relationship management and CRM discipline. • Contribute repeatable content formats or communication practices that can be adopted by other Specialists. This job description outlines the primary duties and standards of the role and is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties may be adjusted according to business needs. Workload structure, escalation pathways, and coaching practices will be administered in accordance with applicable company policies and requirements.
